range_resolution.method: document order over the 108 cards in 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.md (D1..D20, 6+5+4+7+5+5+5+6+5+... per the Counts table at :94-116)
range_resolution.corroborating_signal: sibling range bp-3 wrote bp-req-03..05, bp-arc-01..05, bp-pln-01..04 = document-order 25-36, so its boundary ends exactly one card before BP-PLN-05. Two independent signals agree on the partition.
range_resolution.collision_check: 0 duplicate workflow ids across every *.json in platform/workflows (measured over 69 workflow documents at write time; test_no_id_collides_with_another_range_in_the_shared_directory re-measures on every run)

merged_or_split.basis: measured pairwise mechanism distinctness, not judgement - see BP4-DISTINCTNESS.json. Max pairwise Jaccard over 66 pairs = 0.200 (stale-mega-pr-reconcile vs worktree-isolated-parallel-build, which share only git-shaped tokens); a renamed clone of one blueprint scores 1.000, proving the detector fires. No pair came near the 0.35 ceiling, so nothing needed merging; nothing was split because every card's distinctive mechanism is already encoded as a distinct gate/topology rather than as prose.

blueprints.distinctive_mechanism: conflict surface MEASURED on a throwaway merge before planning; per-file-class resolution recipe; runtime-dependent values deferred rather than guessed
the ABSENCE of a fan-out barrier (no cohort-wide wait), plus a cross-vendor self-certification gate and coverage read from the project SSOT
pre-creation before any unit starts, explicit base_ref merge-base assertion, empty-index staged-deletions guard, and a RECORDED downgrade when isolation is unavailable
selection by executed behaviour on synthesised divergence inputs; cross-vendor agreement is the signal; an explicit equivalence verdict instead of a manufactured winner
the RED capture is a stored schema-valid receipt of the runner's real output at a recorded pre-fix sha, and the capture step is explicitly NO-RETRY
propose-only as a POLICY property (merge tooling in tool_policy.deny), two disjoint credential scopes as separate secret_ref params, and a deadline barrier that reports late runners
per-shard launch verification keyed on each shard's own run id (a workspace-wide count is meaningless on shared prod), plus explicit-timeout and content-postcondition gates
probe ordering by cost-to-discrimination as a first-class stage gating a convergence loop, with Edit/Write denied so no fix can precede the explanation
a fixture PAIR with asymmetric gates (non-firing on broken is fatal; an unconstructible broken state is UNVALIDATABLE), byte-equality across both runs, and brokenness proven without the probe
source_probe is a required non-empty invocation-shaped param (an undeclared source is zero signals), independence is a NAMED dimension, and the checkpoint fails on timeout
non-contamination as a STRUCTURAL property: the child is declared as an INLINE workflow with a two-parameter surface that has no field for prior reasoning
four-way cross-check handler -> registration -> generator event tuple -> observed fire; LIVE requires an observed fire; read-only, and the only blueprint here with no human checkpoint

capability_coverage.absence_is_honest_because: document-order 37-48 covers planning tail, implementation and debugging. No card in this range is a product/design/strategy workflow, and inventing one would be padding. That domain is covered by other ranges (D15-ux, D19-decision-support).

flagship.pro_rata_floor: 40 of 96 = 41.67%, so 5 of 12; this range declares 6

both_states_controls.principle: every check that reports an ABSENCE is paired with a mutation that must make it fail; a check silent in both states measures nothing
whole_set_controls: schema validator armed per document (unknown top-level key must be rejected) - 12 controls
semantic checker armed per document (dangling depends_on must be caught by DSL-SEM-002) - 12 controls
work-unit-ref resolver catches a planted phantom ZZZ-9999
schema-reference resolver returns None for a planted missing file and a Path for a known-present one
inline-sentinel rule catches a sentinel naming a different unit
distinctness detector scores a renamed clone at exactly 1.000 while the real max is 0.200
both_states_controls.schema_legality_of_key_mutations: explicitly asserted for the load-bearing ones (adding a cohort barrier, defaulting base_ref to HEAD, dropping the green-before-fix clause, making source_probe optional, proceed-on-timeout, registration-implies-live) - each is VALID DSL, so only the flagship test rejects it. That is why the tests exist rather than a schema rule.

known_gaps.gap: the confidence vocabulary in the design library (CONF: very-likely 80-90%, very-unlikely 5-20%) is NOT a subset of the DSL's confidence_band enum (almost-certain, likely, roughly-even, unlikely, remote)
known_gaps.impact: a blueprint card whose CONF is very-likely cannot carry that value into its DSL estimate; this range mapped very-likely -> almost-certain or likely per card and says so here
known_gaps.status: REPORTED, not fixed - widening the enum is a schema change outside this unit's scope
